document.abstract: Photography has played a major role in the development of art interest in America chiefly because of its mass appeal and ease of execution. The early growth of art photography was slow but with the formation of an increasing number of camera clubs, and finally several national groups, the movement was fastly accelerated. With the coming of the miniature camera and the successful organization of the Photographic Society of America the continual progress of photo-pictorialism was assured.
